title: Elara — Adhyay 1: Farz
subtitle: Dushman ki princess chains mein… aur key tumhare paas hai.

lines: Wo pehli roshni mein tumhare liye aate hain. Dungeon nahi — guardhouse ke paas bina khidki ka kamra, aur darwaza khulte hi dil ruk jata hai: beech mein khambe se bandhi Nessa hai.
Chheh mahine baad pehli baar dekh rahe ho. Patli, peeli, kapda phata — par zinda, aur jab wo tumhe dekhti hai dara chehra itni poori raahat se sikudta hai ki almost ghutnon par gira deta hai.
"Tum aaye," wo saans chhodti hai. "Mujhe pata tha tum—"

"Shant," Vance kehta hai, kone se nikalta. Wo mez par rakhi chhadi par haath rakhta hai. "Princess ke paas ek raaz hai jise dard nahi hila saka. To hum use ek wajah denge jo uske baare mein bilkul nahi." Wo chhadi tumhe thamata hai, handle pehle. "Bees waar. Tum doge. Phir princess ko theek bataoge kya kiya, aur bheekh mangoge ki rukwaye."
"Nahi," tum khud ko kehte sunte ho. "Mujhe le lo—"

"Tumhe chot pahunchane se kuch nahi hota," Vance kehta hai, beparwah. "Par *use* chot — wo cheez hai jo princess *tum* mein nahi sah paayegi. Chhadi lo, ya main use aise aadmi ko dunga jo maza lega, aur chalis kar denge."
Wahi hisaab jo pehli raat se tumhara malik hai. Tumhare haath se bees waar, jitne naram himmat ho — ya kisi aur se kahin badtar.
Tum chhadi lete ho, haath kampata. Nessa mudkar chehra dhundhti hai, aur jab samajhti hai, cheekhti nahi. Sthir ho jati hai.

"Theek hai," wo aansuon mein kehti hai. "Maine chetavani khodi. Janti hoon tum nahi ho, jaise uske saath bhi tum kabhi nahi the. Tumhara haath unke se better. Karo. Main bees sah sakti hoon." Wo chehra phir khambe ki taraf modti hai aur kandhe jamati aur intezaar karti — unnis saal ki, jitni himmat kabhi na chahiye thi usse zyada.
Tum pehla waar jitna halka himmat ho karte ho — phir bhi padta hai, aur aag ki patli rekha peeth par khilti hai. "Ek," Vance ginta hai.
Tum khud ko doosra, teesra karne majboor karte ho. Paanchve tak wo khuleaam ro rahi; aathve tak cheekhen chhoti anchaahe vinti ban chuki — tumhe nahi, sirf shareer duniya se rukne ki bheekh.

Aadhe raaste wo phir aankhen dhundhti hai, bahti, aur phir bhi kuch thaamne ko dene ki koshish. "Chalte raho," wo hanfti hai. "Tumse poore bees better *uske* ek aur minute se. Mere saath raho. Mere saath gino."
Tum sir mein uske saath ginte ho, baarah, terah, chaudah, har sankhya ek chhoti private maafi jo kabhi kaafi nahi. Vance shant dhyan se dekhta hai jaise koi theory pakka kar raha ho.

Bees par tum chhadi girate ho aur faisla karne se pehle khambe par ho, use thaamte jaise bahon mein dhalti hai. Kampti, phooli, par zinda aur hosh mein, aur pehli cheez jo karti hai asteen jakadna. "Dekha? Bees. Kaha tha. Hum theek hain."
"Chhu lene wala," Vance kehta hai, chhadi wapas leta. "Use wapas le jao," wo sipahiyon se kehta hai, aur darwaza us par band hota hai, tumhe superintendent aur aage ke lambe raaste ke saath chhodta.
"Ab," Vance kehta hai, coat jhaadta. "Princess ke paas neeche. Batao kya kiya, koi detail mat bachao — main pahredaron se poochhunga. Aur phir bheekh mango."

"Iska shape samjho. Aaj bees waar the. Kal badtar, har din chadhta, jab tak ya to Everspring de ya hafta khatm aur hum phir bhi phansi den. Tumhare paas chheh din hain kisi jaan bachane ko manane ke. Salah hai impressive bano."
Saat seedhiyan kabhi itni lambi nahi lagi. Elara tumhare jooton par sir uthati hai, phir chehra dekhti hai, khoon jo tumhara nahi, aur bhaav badalta hai. "Unhone kya kiya," wo kehti hai. Sawal nahi.
To tum ghutne tekte ho aur batate ho. Nessa ke baare mein, khamba, chhadi, bees waar jo khud ke haath ne diye. Har shabd uske upar alag chot ki tarah girta dekhte ho.

Jab khatm karte ho, Elara khamosh hai, phir bahut dheemi aur sthir: "To yahi uska khel hai. Mere shareer se nahi tod saka, to tumhare se todega. Uski se." Aankhen band. "Mere apne maans ke liye koi yaatna nahi jo wo soch chhue jitna ki wo ladki chhadi ke neeche meri khamoshi ki wajah se."
Wo aankhen kholti hai, geeli aur tez. "Ab tum bheekh mangoge. Usne kaha. To mango. Khatm karo."
Aur tum nahi kar sakte. Sach mein bheekh mangna use duniya ke sabse cruel aadmi ko amar rehne ki taakat thamaana kehna hai, aur dar se better koi hissa muh se wo vinti nahi banne deta.

"Nahi kar sakta," tum bajaye fusfusate ho. "Maine *use* dekha hai. Agar aisa aadmi kabhi na mare— par wo meri behen hai, unnis ki, aur mujhe *nahi* pata kya karun. Poori zindagi pehli baar nahi pata kya karun." Tum sir jhukate ho, aur ek bada aadmi dungeon ke floor par toot jata hai.

Elara jitna bandhan dete hain aage jhukti hai, awaaz us kali jagah ki sabse naram cheez. "Tum bheekh nahi mangoge, aur main nahi tootungi — aaj nahi. Hum is aadmi se chalaak hain, aur chheh mein se pehle din ghabrakar jeetne nahi denge."

"Chheh din," wo fusfusati hai. "Usne chheh din diye teesra raasta dhundhne — jo na meri khamoshi use maare na mera raaz duniya ko shaapit kare. Hamesha teesra raasta hota hai. Dhundhne mein madad karo."
Tum us raat seedhiyan chadhte ho kuch hal nahi, aur peeche andhere mein, pehli baar, princess marne ka intezaar nahi kar rahi. Wo plan banana shuru kar rahi hai.
— Adhyay 11 samaapt —

Doosra din. Wo mashalein badalne se pehle aaye, aur Elara ki kothri nahi — nange kamre mein, floor mein naali aur lambi lohe ki naand itne thande paani se bhari ki kinaron par barf jam gayi. Vance pehle se wahan tha. Uske paas stool se bandhi, usi phate kapde mein, Nessa.
Unnis saal ki, kalaiyan peeche bandhi, hoth is thand ki raat se pehle hi dhoosar-neele, aankhen tumhari dhundhti us aatank ke saath jo tumhare liye nigalne ki itni koshish karti.
"Accha. Bhai." Vance barfiili surface par do ungliyan pherita. "Thand magistrate ko dikhane kuch nahi chhodti aur bhai ko yaad rakhne sab."

"Tum use dubaaoge. Main nahi. Tum. Har baar main sawal poochhun aur khamoshi pasand na aaye, uska chehra paani mein, aur tum das ginte rehna jab wo thodi doobe. Aur jab sah na sako, apni princess ko batane jaoge behen sukhana iklauta tarika hai Everspring kahan hai batana."
"Mujhe nahi pata kahan hai. Main pahredar hoon," tumne kaha.
"Beshak nahi. Main tumse nahi poochh raha — *istemaal* kar raha hoon. Wo tumhe isse bachane baat karegi." Usne naand ki taraf ishara kiya. "Shuru karo."
Kamre mein do aur aadmi khade the. Tum bimaar spashtata se samajh gaye, agar mana kiya, wo karenge, aur das nahi ginenge.

To tum behen ke peeche ghutne teke aur patle kandhon par haath rakhe. "Nessa," tum saans mein. "Jab dabaaun saans rok. Upar laaunga. Kasam." Usne sir hilaya — ek chhoti, kampti haan — aur wo tumhare andar kuch toot gaya jo tab se juda nahi.
"Everspring kahan hai?" Vance ne khaali hawa se poocha. Khamoshi. "Neeche."
Tumne apni behen ka chehra barf-paani mein dhakela aur gina jab wo tadapti, hanfti zinda upar khinchi, aur Vance ne phir kaha, aur tumne phir kiya.

Chaar baar. Paanch. Tum bhool gaye kitni baar bachi iklauti khoon ko dubaya aur wapas laya. Beech mein wo tumhara naam sisakti — kabhi dosh mein nahi, wo asahaniya tha — jaise bachcha us ek insan se kahe jo rukwane wala mana jata hai ki please rukwa do.
"Subah ke liye kaafi," Vance ne aakhir kaha, ubaa. "Neeche jao. Bheekh mango. Jab samajhdar hone ko taiyar ho tab lautna."
Unhone Nessa ko wapas ghasitne se pehle tumhare coat mein lapetne diya — jitni daya jeet sake. Phir Elara ke andhere ki taraf chale, asteenen bheegi, na jaante kaise kahoge.
Usne bolne se pehle paani suna, jaise hamesha. "Tum geele ho," wo shant boli. "Unhone kya karwaya."
Aur tumne bataya — naand, barf, apne haath, Nessa tumhara naam kehti. Wo sirf tumhari awaaz se le saki, jo apni cruelty hai. Tumne mehsoos kiya chains mein wo bahut shant ho gayi jaise bole.

"Wo use yaatna nahi de raha," usne aakhir kaha, dheemi aur samajh se bhayaanak. "*Tumhe* yaatna de raha. Uske zariye, mere zariye — yantra baja raha wo sur dhundhne ko jo mera muh khole. Wo bahut accha hai. To hum aise ladna band karte hain. Ab se, wo ek cheez karte hain jiski wo nigraani nahi kar raha."
"Kaun si cheez," tumne kaha.
"Hum *dekhna* shuru karte hain. Chheh din — wo todne ke liye kehta rehta. Main use karungi. Har baar wo tumhe todne neeche bheje, tum mujhe kamra laaoge."

"Jab in galiyaron mein chalo, toota aadmi bheekh mangta — use yakeen rehne do. Par bheekh mangte *gino.* Pahre ki badli par seedhi ke pahredar. Mashalein kab badalti aur chaabiyan kaun le jata. Thandi hawa kahan se aati — bahar ka raasta, hamesha. Upar ki beam par rassi, us nange kamre ki naali, darwaza jo wo kabhi poora band nahi karte."

"Abhi kuch plan mat. Bas kamra laao, tukde-tukde, jab tak main andhere mein chal sakun. Raat ki badli par pahredar gino. Kal wo laao. Hamare paas chheh din hain, aur main unhe shok mein kharch karna band kar chuki."
Tum us raat seedhi chadhe asteenen abhi bheegi — par pehli baar, ginte. Nichli landing par do pahredar, upri par ek, teesri pahredari par mashal-wahak baayi kamar par chaabiyan.
Chhoti cheezein. Kuch nahi cheezein. Sab kuch ki shuruaat. Chheh mein se doosra din khatm — chaar aur, aur ek sipahi jisne aakhir, chupchaap, jeetne ka faisla kar liya.
— Adhyay 12 samaapt —

Naand ke baad ke din ek dhoosar dard mein ghul gaye. Vance ka lever — chhadi, thand, bheekh ka chakra — kaam nahi kar raha tha. Chauthe din raja ne poore design se dhairya khoya: khabar aayi Nessa table se hata di gayi, sadharan kothri mein, khilai, bina chhue.

Iska matlab tumhare gale ki rassi bhi dheeli pad gayi. Un dhundhli raaton mein tum Elara ko kamra laate rahe, tukde-tukde — pahre ki badli, chaabiyan, eent band naali se thandi hawa — jab tak bhagna almost taiyar na ho.
Phir unhone bataya phansi bhor ko tay hai — aur aaj raat, raja khud aakhri baar poochhne neeche aa raha hai.

Raja Mordane bina dhoomdhaam aaya — lamba, bina jaldbaazi ka aadmi saade oon mein, kandhe par jadugar, chaar sipahi kapde ke neeche kuch bhaari uthaye. Thaka clerk lagta tha. Wahi uske baare mein sabse darawna tha.
"To yahi hai," wo bola, chains mein Elara ko parakhta. "Kahaniyon se chhoti." Aankhen tum par gayin. "Aur yahi hai jo us par fida ho gaya. Ruko. Mujhe gawah chahiye jo mehsoos kare."
Sipahiyon ne kapda hataya — kale lohe ka ghumawdar frame, chaap cruel shikhar tak. Palna, agar palna us cheez ko todne ke liye bana ho jise thaame.

"Patti utaro," raja bola. "Main chahta hoon wo apne raja ko samajhdar dekhe." Aur tumse: "Use is par litane mein madad karo. Kaha gaya tumhare haath naram hain. Istemaal karo. Yeh aakhri narmi hogi jo kisi se milegi."

Unhone tumhe majboor kiya uski kamar lohe ke shikhar par rakho, kalaiyan ek taraf, takhne doosri, jab tak poora shareer ghumaw par peeche na mud jaye. Usne koi awaaz nahi ki — sirf aankhen dhundhin aur thaamin: tumhari galti nahi, hum khatm nahi.
Phir sipahiyon ne cuffs se wazan taange, chaap gehra hua, aur chhati par aadhe bhare chaabuk ke nishan phat gaye, taaza khoon lohe mein bahta. Wo hanfi, pehli awaaz, daanton ke beech.

Raja jhuka, aur chhoti mitti ki jar nikali. "Namak aur sirka," usne kaha, tumhe thamate. "Sabse naram haath tumhare, to tumhare hone chahiye. Mana karo, to jadugar karega, aur tum uske saath kode khaoge. Jaldi chuno."

To tumhare haathon ne namak aur sirka uski chhati ki phati rekhaon mein daale, aur jo cheekh phati dungeon bhar gayi. Wo janti thi tum ho, aur phir bhi dosh nahi diya. "Everspring kahan hai, Elara?" raja cheekhon par poocha, jaise koi ghanta pooche.

Wo lohe par royi aur kampi, aur jab shabd bana saki, wo wo nahi the jo wo chahta. "Tumhe mujhse kuch nahi milega, clerk-raja. Jharna mere saath marta hai. Jo aadmi hamesha jeena chahe use *kabhi* ijazat nahi."
Mordane ke thake chehre par kuch chamka — gussa nahi. Almost samman. Gusse se bura tha.

Raja gusse mein nahi phoota. Sir hilaya, jaise usne kuch pakka kiya, aur jar phir tumhare haathon mein dabaya. "Phir, gehra. Aur meri peshkash suno, princess — ek baar. Ek shabd aur bhor ki phansi nahi. Shant kamra, khidki, behen Liora hamesha safe. Bolo, aur dono saans lete bahar chalo."
"Dalo," usne dheere kaha. "Use namak mein sochne do."

To tumne phir dala, aur wo phir cheekhi, muda shareer chains ke khilaaf marodata — aur phir, aur phir. "Everspring kahan hai?" Chhu. Cheekh. "Liora, safe. Ek zindagi." Chhu. Cheekh. Usne kabhi awaaz nahi uthayi, yakeen ki har koi tootta hai agar tum kaafi shant raho.

Tum wahan khade aurat mein peeda daalte jisse pyaar karte ho kyunki option jadugar ke cruel haath aur uske paas frame tha. Aur wo nahi tooti — na namak ke liye, na zindagi ki peshkash ke liye, na raja ke muh mein Liora ke naam ke liye. Peeche mudi, chhati khuli, usne jharna nahi diya.
Raja seedha hua. "Aur wazan. Bade patthar. Kalaiyan aur takhnon dono par taango — chahta hoon reedh seekhe kisse bahas kar rahi hai."

Tum aur ek sipahi ne cuffs se khadaan-patthar taange, aur har ek ke saath chaap shareer ke bane se aage gehra hua, reedh khinchi twacha ke neeche khadi. Har ek par usne awaaz ki jo baaki zindagi sunoge.
Chaar patthar tange, raja ne khula haath uski tanti pet par rakha. "Tum phir kabhi na khade hone se ek ungli ki doori par ho, princess. Ek aur patthar, ya chaar shabd — *yeh hai* — aur naam."

"Ek," usne kaha. "Do." Aur *teen* par — jab tum paanchve patthar bahon mein jamaye jame the — usne saans khinchi aur dhaage jaisi awaaz mein kaha: "Pehle... jala doongi." Uske dhairya mein kuch aakhir patla pada.

Wo khada hua, aur joote ka talwa uski nangi gardan par rakha — dheere, naapa, saans ki nali par dabav jab wo pin thi aur sir nahi ghuma sakti. Chehra gehra ho gaya; tum aadha kadam lapke isse pehle bhale ka danda chhati mein laga.

Bilkul kinare par, usne joota uthaya, ek phephde bharne diya, aur naram poocha: "Everspring kahan hai?" Usne nahi bola. Teen baar usne use andhere ke kinare tak le gaya aur teen baar usne saans ki jagah khamoshi di.

Raja pehle ruka, daya se nahi. Usne khaali jar tumhare haathon se li aur use achraj jaisi cheez se dekha. "Gyarah saal maine us paani ka shikar kiya, aur aakhri darwaza ek ladki jo kholne se pehle jal jayegi."
"Par main dhairyavaan hoon, aur ek raat bachi hai. Ise aise hi chhodo — patthar rahein, mod rahe. Aur nahi chahta wo soye. Basin lagao."
Unhone upar pinhole wala tambe ka basin taanga aur tumhe tapakta upar khinchne diya — thanda paani raat bhar uske upar muh aur kachche ghaavon par, bas itni baar ki neend mein nahi ja sake.

"Bhor tak," raja bola, pehli boondein girte dekh, "ya to jharna de ya shehar ko shant phansi. Dono kaam aate." Seedhi par rukkar, almost khud se: "Afsos. Yeh poore mahal mein iklauti imaandaar cheez thi."
Phir wo chala gaya. "Tumhara maksad poora, naram haath," Vance bola, tumhe seedhiyon ki taraf le jata jab do taaze pahredar duty lete. "Bhor ko wapas milegi, jo bache, rassi tak chalane ke liye."

Tum lambi seedhi chadhe basin ki tapak andhere mein peeche-peeche — joote mein aadhi kati chaabi aur neend ki dawa, aur do taaze pahredaron se paar pahunchne ka koi raasta nahi. Bhor phansi hai. Tum bhi nahi soye.
— Adhyay 13 samaapt —

Bhor dhoosar aur pakki aayi. Unhone use palne se utara — teen din bina neend aur raat peeche mude se wo mushkil se khadi ho pa rahi; reedh ek saath seedhi nahi hoti, har charan par awaaz faadti. Unhone aadhi ghasit use roshni mein nikala jo hafton nahi dekhi thi.
Poora shehar aaya tha, chauk kandhe se kandha thasa, aur jab wo aayi, palak jhapkaati aur tooti, jo awaaz unhone banayi insan ki nahi thi — das hazaar galon ki nafrat ki deewar.

Unhone use rassi ke neeche machaan par khada kiya. Raja Mordane ne ek haath uthaya aur chauk shant ho gaya. "Rajdhani ke log, is aurat se ek cheez mangi gayi jo jaan kharidti. Ek baar aur poochhunga, jahan sab sun saken." Wo uski taraf muda. "Everspring, Elara. Bolo, aur jiyo. Khamosh raho, aur ye acche log tumhe girte dekhein."

Usne sir uthaya, aur poore chauk ko apna barbaad chehra dikhaya. "Tumhara raja hamesha jeena chahta hai. Yahi raaz hai jiske liye usne teen hafte yaatna di. Suraksha nahi — *hamesha.* Khud poocho aisa aadmi hazaar saal mein kya karta hai." Wo dagmagayi, sambhali. "Main aaj marungi taaki wo na jee sake. Yeh tumhare bachchon ko ab tak ka sabse accha tohfa hai. Rassi khincho."

Yeh raja ke liye galat cheez thi. Bheed mein badbadaahat daudi — bechaini ki jhalak, das hazaar saron mein sawal: *hamesha?* Wo bardasht nahi kar sakta tha rassi us shabd hawa mein latke shaheed bana de.
"Nahi," usne kaha, haath neeche. "Jaldi girna usne jo kamaya uske liye bahut saaf hai. Aaj wo *tumhe* jawab degi."
Unhe use machaan ke kinare pillory mein band kiya — bhaari oak frame gardan aur kalaiyan jakadta, aage jhuki bebas.

"Teen hafte mere poochhtachh karne walon ke paas rahi, kuch nahi mila," raja pukara. "Shayad jinka nuksaan kiya wo better karein. Shaam tak yahan khadi rahe. Sirf mare nahi — phansi meri hai, jab chunun."
Usne tumhe aur pahredaron ki qatar pillory ke paaye par lagayi — uski raksha nahi, apni property ki. Tumhare orders: bheed ko maarne se roko, aur uske alawa sab karne do.
To tum us aurat aur shehar ke beech khade rahe jo use marta chahta, talwar sirf badtar maut ke liye zinda rakhne ki ijazat.

Wo baadh mein aaye — sada phal, gandagi, thook — poora shehar nafrat us aurat par khaali karta jo aankhen ponchhne haath bhi nahi utha sakti. Ek boodhe ne switch se chehre par mara jab tak pahredar peeche na dhakelen.
Kuch ne yeh kamaya tha — aurat rote hue phenkti, aadmi har patthar par bete ka naam. Elara ne unke khet jalaye the. Us chauk mein shok asli tha, aur khade hone ki koi saaf jagah nahi.

Dopahar tak ek aurat kainchi lekar chadhi aur garjan mein baal kaat diye; keechad mein gire aur raunde gaye. Phenke patthar ne maatha khola aur khoon aankhon mein bahta jo ponchh nahi sakti — aur phir bhi, har ghante, jakda sir oak jitna upar uthati aur unka saamna karti, aur unke liye nahi roti, aur bheekh nahi mangti.

Do baar, aadmiyon ne maarne wale patthar phenke. Dono baar tum bina faisla kiye hil gaye — shield ne ek liya, doosre ka baaju kaat diya. Usne mehsoos kiya. Ek baar, jab kaafi paas the, phate hothon se do shabd saans mein, sirf tumhare liye: "Abhi nahi." Keh rahi thi thaame raho — das hazaar gawahon ke saamne bachane sab barbaad mat karo.
Yeh tab tak chala jab roshni amber ho gayi aur bheed ka baaju thak gaya. Shaam tak chauk khaali ho raha tha, aur pillory mein jo bacha mushkil se hilta.

Vance use kholne aaya. "Abhi saans le rahi," usne note kiya, barbaad chehra thuddi se uthata. "Raja ne rassi ke liye naya din nahi tay kiya. Jab tootogi tab phansi, pehle nahi. Kal ho sakta hai. Lamba, bahut lamba waqt ho sakta hai."

Unhe use andhere mein le gaye, aur tum wahi the jisne gandagi aur khoon dhoye, haath kamapte. Tum dono ne nahi kaha jo dono ab jaante: phansi ki tareekh nahi bachi *pehle* bhagne ko — sirf khule dinon ka failav jismein raja chot pahunchayega jab tak mar na jaye, koi schedule nahi sirf uska dhairya.
Jis ghadi se tum daud rahe the gayi. Aur bina deadline ka aadmi perfect raat ka intezaar band karta hai, aur ek banana shuru karta hai.

Wo us raat aakhir soyi, shareer ki mari neend jismein kuch nahi bacha, nanga sir tumhari god mein, peeth kothri ke darwaje ki taraf — jabki tum jaage baithe pahredar ginte, pahre ki badli, eent naali ki thandi saans, aadhi kati chaabi ungliyon mein palatte.
Koi deadline nahi. Koi perfect raat nahi. Sirf ek princess jisne poore shehar ko sach kaha aur jee gayi, aur ek pahredar jiske paas intezaar ki wajahen aakhir, poori tarah, khatm ho gayin.
— Adhyay 14 samaapt —

Raja ke paas ab calendar nahi tha, aur isse wo badtar ho gaya. Din wo sadne deta, phir naya raasta dhundha: tumhari behen. "Darwaze ke peeche dard afwah hai," usne kaha. "Suraj mein dard lever hai. Wahan karenge jahan shehar dekhe wo chunti hai."
Unhone deewaron ke neeche khule maidan mein banaya: lakdi ka A-frame, shikhar par pulley-wheel, dono sire par phanda cuff wali ek rassi. Bheed pehle se jut rahi — wahi shehar jisne patthar mare.
Unhone *tumse* lagwaya. Vance tumhare sir par khada jab tumne behen ki kalaiyan bandhin, phir princess ki, aur rassi piroi, gaanth-gaanth seekhte cruelty kaise kaam karti hai.

Vance bheed ko showman ki tarah samjhata gaya. "Saada, aur sahi. Is taraf ladki kamzor. Princess mazboot, to mazboot ko kamzor ko dhone dete. Mahamahim par wazan taangte — jab tak thaame, ladki aaram se khadi. Jis pal princess dhalti, ladki bandhe baazuon se zameen se upar khinchi jati jab tak kandhe jagah chhod den. Princess apni taakat se tay karti hai bachchi ko chot lage ya nahi."

Phir unhone use load kiya — kalai cuff par lohe ki salaakh par salaakh, baaju upar-peeche khinchte jab tak wo bhi ek dheemi janwar jaisi awaaz na kare. Minuton mein kandhon ki twacha gehari, gussail laal ho gayi, khoon phansa aur dhadakta jahan rassiyan kaatti.
Nessa, khud ko sthir rakhne itni kamzor, baar-baar jhukti; har baar dagmagati khinchav princess ko panjon par khinchta, kandhe cheekhte, jab tak eddi phir neeche laakar dono sthir na kare.

"Sthir raho, Nessa," Elara khaali jagah paar saans mein. "Lado mat, jaan. Main tumhe thaame hoon. Khadi raho, aur mujhe dono thaamne do." Tumhari behen royi aur koshish ki, aur har nakami princess baazuon mein chukai — aur ek baar bhi rassi use girne nahi di.
Raja dekhta raha, asantusht — thaamna todna nahi. "Vance. Girne ki wajah do, aur dekhein apni twacha bachane ladki girati hai ya nahi. Chaabuk maro."

Vance ke chehre par cruelty se buri cheez jali — kritagyata. Yahan kripa mein wapsi ka raasta tha, aur wo princess ke shareer par se jata. "Tumne mujhe bahut keemat chukai, Mahamahim," wo dheere bola. "Kuch lautane do."

Pehla chaabuk chhati par gira, aadhe bhare nishanon par, phir nanga. Par asli cruelty jo mangta: agar hichke aur baaju ek hatheli bhi gire, Nessa zameen se phat jayegi. To hichak nahi sakti — har waar mari sthir khadi sahna, chaabuk us shareer mein sokhna jise hilne mana.

Vance chaabuk baar-baar aage marta, aur har ek bina gire mila. Chaabukon ke beech usne use gaali nahi di na raja se bheekh — tumhari behen se boli. "Almost khatm, Nessa. Qatar mein bhai dekho — wo tumhe ghar le jayega. Bas khadi raho, jaan."
Tum pahredar-qatar mein khade jahan usne ladki ko dekhne kaha, sabse bahadur cheez dekhte jo kabhi dekhi, jaante gaanthen tumne bandhin jinhone ise mumkin kiya.

Ek baar, Nessa ke pair poori tarah gaye, aur rassi Elara ko poori zameen se upar khinch li, aakhir cheekhi — phir panja neeche layi, khincha, aur hanfi, "Theek hai. Main thaame hoon. Khadi raho." Wo rassi par mar jati ladki girane se pehle. Sab dekh sakte the, raja bhi.

Vance ka baaju pehle thaka. Usne kisi ginati se aage chaabuk mara, aur wo nahi giri, jharna nahi diya, Nessa ko hawa nahi chhune diya — yaatna dene wala jo shikar nahi tod sakta sabke saamne atoot sabit kar chuka.
Raja utha aur khatm kiya, daya se nahi. "Bas. Utaro." Saans mein: "...use tootna chahiye tha. Kyun nahi tootti."

Unhone loha neeche kiya. Nessa, poori, ek aurat ne kachchi chaabuk sahkar ek inch nahi giraya, tumhari bahon mein dhal gayi; Elara mitti mein mudi, baaju galat latakte, hosh sirf itna ki ladki poori dekhe.
"Kaha tha," wo fusfusayi. "Maine use thaama."

Us raat tum andhere mein dono ke beech baithe, aur andar kuch badalna khatm hua. Koi deadline nahi harane, koi perfect raat aane — sirf ek aurat jo khud ko nasht hone degi isse pehle uski cruelty jeete.
Us raat tumne aadhi kati chaabi ungliyon mein nahi palati. Tumne kaatna khatm kiya.
— Adhyay 15 samaapt —

Taiyar hone mein do din lage — kaatna, ghisna, bhagne ko jo chahiye churana: rassi ki kundli, nadi ke outflow ke neeche narkat mein chhipi naav, sookhe kapde, neeli sheeshi jo banane ke din se joote mein sawaar.

Teesri raat, mahal ne khidki di: great hall mein Vance ka bhoj, chowki uski sehat peeti jab tak mashalein na kampen, aur nadi par chadhta toofan, kala paani phoolta, raat shor mein dubota. Jitna intezaar kiya ek saath aaya. Tumne intezaar band kiya.

Tumne dungeon-pahre ko khud sharab pahunchayi, neeli sheeshi anguthe se jug mein khaali. Chauthaai ghante mein nichli landing dono aadmi kharraate le rahe. Teesri pahredari ka mashal-wahak apne ghante aaya, aur jab muda tumne dheere neeche baithaya aur kamar se chaabi ka chhalla uthaya. Do darwazon jitna loha. Nessa, aur Elara.

Pehle uske paas gaye — koi compass wahin ishara karta aur bahas nahi sunta. Sabse gehri kothri kaali aur band, patthar se toofan ki awaaz aur uski uthli, savdhaan saans. Haath itna kampa chaabi taale par khankhanayi ghumne se pehle, aur darwaza jo sau baar band kiya pehli baar tumhare liye khula.
Usne galat awaaz suni aur puwal mein peeche hichki, sahara leti jo bhi nayi cheez unhone banayi ho. "...jo bhi hai," wo fusfusayi, "karo aur sone do. Phir bhi nahi kahungi—"

"Elara." Tum ghutnon par the jaane se pehle. "Main hoon. Suno — pahredari neeche hai, toofan dhak raha, bhoj ne baaki ko nasha diya, aur nadi ki naali ke neeche narkat mein naav hai. Samajhti ho kya keh raha hoon?"
Wo bahut shant hui, phir ek saath jaagi. "Phir kaho," saans mein. "Saaf, taaki jaanoon tum ho, mera dimaag cruel nahi."
"Aaj raat," tumne kaha, thanda chehra dono haathon mein. "Aaj raat main tumhe yahan se nikalta hoon. Dono ko. Sirf hum, deewar mein chhed, aur nadi. Tumhe ghar le ja raha hoon."

Usne awaaz banayi jo na siski na hansi aur dono, aur geela chehra tumhari hatheli mein dabaya — wahi haath jisne pehli raat rassiyan dheeli kin aur sabse bure din ghaavon mein namak dala. Ki wo abhi bhi uski taraf mude poori tarah toot gaya.
"Theek hai," wo twacha par fusfusayi. "Main maanti hoon. Ye utaro aur andhere se nikalo."

Tumne chhukar cuff paaye — kalaiyan wazan se kachchi aur papdi — aur loha utne naram khola jitna kamapte haath den. Jab aakhri giri, baaju bekaar gire, kandhe itne marode ki utha na saken. Usne chhoti tooti hansi di. "Kaam nahi karte. Samaan ki tarah uthakar le jaana hoga."
"To uthaunga," tumne kaha. "Ek raat mujhe mazboot wala banne do."

Usne maatha tumhare se tikaya, shareer ka iklauta hissa jo abhi manta, aur wahin saans leti rahi. "Jaante ho," budbudayi, "barf ke baad jo iklauti naram cheez hui wo tum ho. Unhone zinda rakhne pahredar bheja taaki nasht kar saken, aur bajaye wahi wajah bana kuch bacha rakhne layak. Main hazaar wajahon se tiki. Aakhri tum the."

Aur phir — upar toofan, neeche naav, intezaar ki poori zindagi is ek pal par dabav — tumne andhere ka aakhri inch band kiya aur chooma. Naram, phate hoth ka khayal, chumban jo kuch nahi mangta aur sab waada karta. Wo baaju nahi utha saki, to shareer jo abhi saump sakta wahi diya — wapas chooma, tez aur kampata aur zinda, jabki baarish girti rahi.

Jab alag hue wo ro rahi aur muskurayi ek saath, aur tum bhi. "Pahredari sirf nashe mein, yeh bahut bewakoofi thi. Phir bhi ek baar aur karo." To kiya — phir khud roka, kyunki pyaar deewar paar nahi le jayega aur waqt le jayega. Baahen neeche sarkayin aur puwal se uthaya jismein ek mahine khoon baha.
Wazan almost kuch nahi — apni shok, unhone kitna liya — par chhati se aisa baithi jaise fit hone bani, aur lambi kampti saans chhodi.
"Main tumhe thaame hoon," baalon mein kaha — behen ko uske apne shabd, ab wapas. "Andhera nahi. Ab nahi."
"Sun rahi hoon," fusfusayi. "To jao. Behen lo, aur teeno ko us nadi tak." Aur bhi dheemi: "...main tumhare saath khatm nahi, pahredar. Jab azaad hon, baaki zindagi ki bahut lambi baat hogi."
Tum use dungeon seedhi ke kale gale mein le gaye, dil ki dhadkan pasliyon par, upar toofan garajta, nashe mein pahredari peeche bikhri aur sota mahal nadi tak beech mein.

Do darwazon ka loha jeb mein garam. Ek manzil upar behen intezaar. Khatm nahi — Vance ek hall door apni sehat abhi pee raha — par us pehli seedhi bhar, use dil se lagaye, khud ko yakeen dilaya ki ho sakta hai.
— Adhyay 16 samaapt —
Upri kothriyan sookhi thin, mashalein door-door, thand ab nadi se — deewar paar phoolti aur gussail, toofan khilata.

Tumne Elara ko seedhi-mod ki sabse gehri chhaya mein baithaya. "Nessa upar hai," saans mein. "Aakhri kothri, gallery ke ant, aur ek pahredar. Yahan rukna — mushkil se khadi ho sakti ho." Usne kaam karne wala haath asteen par jakda.
"Maine do saal chains mein kaam ki seekha," fusfusayi. "Jis raat nikli hoon bekaar mat banana. Behen ke liye dono haath chahiye honge. Mujhe wo cheez banne do jiski taraf pahredar dekhe."
Nafrat thi ki sahi hai. "Agar galat ho," tumne kaha, "deewar cheekhkar gira dena aur naali ki taraf bhagna. Mere liye wapas mat aana."
"Jhootha," naram boli. "Tum bhi wo order kabhi nahi manoge." Aur asteen chhod di.

Gallery pahredar, Holt, ubaa tha, peeth kothriyon ki taraf, chehra baarish dekhti khidki-daraar ki taraf. Elara pehle gayi — chalti, rengti nahi, jaise sirf oonche khaandaan wale nange pair aur barbaad bhi chal saken. Usne chain ek baar ghasiti taaki gungunaye. Holt muda, haath dande par, aur danda poori tarah bhool gaya.

"Tum nayi pahredari?" boli, awaaz dheemi aur garam, bhoj ki awaaz, kothri ki nahi. "Khaali kamre pahredari aise aadmi bhejte. Kya barbaadi." Kaidi jitna himmat ho kareeb aayi. "Naam batao, pahredar. Is jagah se ek dayalu chehra yaad rakhna chahoongi."

Kaam nahi karna chahiye tha — Holt ko bataya gaya wo saanp hai — par usne akeeli raat ke akele aadmi par darbaar ka poora jaadu ghumaya, aur wo uski taraf kadam badha, kothriyon se poori tarah muda, aur naam kehne laga.
Uske peeche, tum nange pair gallery chadhe, chaabi ka chhalla mutthi mein gala dabaye taaki khankhanaye nahi.

Nessa ki kothri aakhri thi. Salaakhon se, unnis aur dhoosar-chehra, jaagi, kalaiyan chhoti deewar-chain mein. Wo salaakhon ki taraf jhatki; tumne ek ungli hothon par itni zor se rakhi dard hua. Wo shant aur khamosh ho gayi, sirf aankhen cheekhtin. Taale ne doosri chaabi li aur aise khula jaise roki saans chhooti.

Kalai-chain problem thi — deewar mein dhansi anguthi se rivet, koi chaabi nahi chhuti. Tumne chheni wahan thunsi jahan anguthi patthar se milti, awaaz nigalne coat lapeta. Mortar dheere nikla, geele dhoosar tukdon mein, har kharoch shant mahal mein awaaz.
Gallery neeche, Holt princess ki kisi baat par hansa. Accha. Hansi zor se hoti hai.

Elara use thaame rahi — budbudahat, dheemi hansi, dheeme aadhe ghere mein ghumati jab tak peeth poori gallery ki taraf na ho. Ek baar kuch nahi par chamakdaar khush hansi, theek jab tumhari chheni patthar par cheekhi.

Mortar diya. Anguthi ret ki phuhaar ke saath ukhdi, aur Nessa ki chain tumhare haathon mein dheeli giri. Tumne upar khincha — wazan kuch nahi — aur usne chehra gardan mein dabaya aur kampi, khamosh, aur tumne waise thaama jaise chhoti thi.

"Behen," saans mein. "Main thaame hoon. Hum ja rahe. Ek awaaz nahi." Usne sir hilaya, phir sir uthaya tumhare paar us aurat ko dekhne jo abhi bhi pahredar ko awaaz ki hatheli mein thaame. Chehre par pehchaan. "Wahi hai," hothon se. "Jisse tum neend mein baat karte ho."

Tumne Nessa ki chain chhoti bandhi aur gallery neeche laute. Ab iklauti mushkil Holt — aur aadmi hamesha princess nahi ghoor sakta, raahat baaki aur koi janwar hissa sochta kyun khaali kothriyan taaza toote mortar si gandhti.

Elara ne mudna tumse pehle mehsoos kiya. "Mujhe khidki tak chalo," Holt se khushi se, shareer uski aankhon aur tum teeno ke beech seedhi ki taraf sarkate. "Phansi se pehle toofan dekhna hai." Holt, bebas, use khidki tak le gaya, aur gallery un sab se khaali ho gayi jinke rakhne ka zimma tha.

Tum seedhi-sir par pahunche Nessa peeth se chipki. Elara ne pahredar ko ek aakhri pal diya, phir bas andhere mein bah gayi, tumhara haath kalai paakar seedhiyon neeche khinchta. Holt khaali khidki ko lambe waqt palak jhapkata raha samajhne se pehle ki uske saath hui sabse khoobsurat cheez ek chor thi.
Ab teeno thandi nichli seedhi par — tooti princess, bhookhi behen, pahredar jisne har kasam todi. Baayi mein Nessa ka haath, daayi mein Elara ka, dono aakhir deewar ke ek taraf.
"Naali," Elara fusfusayi. "Humein us deewar tak le chalo jo saans leti hai."

Tum nadi-awaaz aur taiyar naav ki taraf neeche gaye. Peeche mahal sota raha, abhi na jaanta uski sabse cruel kothri khaali aur princess jise phansi deni thi apni neev se bahar chal rahi. Jald jaayega. Par abhi nahi.
— Adhyay 17 samaapt —
Tum unhe neev se neeche le gaye jaise sir mein sau baar chale — thanda nichla raasta jahan naali saans leti, dheele patthar jo darjan raat-pahredari mein khode, andhera jo lohe nahi nadi si gandhta.
Elara chadh nahi sakti aur Nessa mushkil se chal sakti, to dheere gaye, har ek par haath. Saans lete pattharon se shayad tees kadam the jab, upar aur peeche, mahal sona band kar diya.
Ek ghanti se shuru hua. Phir har ghanti.
Vance sone nahi gaya. Kripa mein lauta captain jeet ki raat nahi sota — aur bhoj aur kamron ke beech kahin wo us aurat ko dekhne neeche gaya jisne sab keemat chukai aur wapas di.
Nichli landing kharraate lete aadmiyon se bikhri paayi, kothri khuli aur khaali, puwal par kati chains, abhi garam, aur mashal-wahak ke chhalle se doosri chaabi gayi.
Vance kai cruel cheezein hai par kabhi moorkh nahi. Ek saans mein sab samajh gaya — pahredar, nigahen, kamzor pey, princess jo nahi tooti — aur sir peeche phenk mahal ko cheekhkar jaga diya.

Order uski awaaz mein nikla, seedhiyon neeche thande paani ki tarah: "Gaddar ke paas dushman princess aur apni behen hai! Har faatak, har deewar! Jo saans leti wapas laaye sona — aur pahredar ka sir mujhe khud chahiye!"

Saikdon joote, ek saath, kile ke har galiyaare. Tum saans lete pattharon par pahunche aur kandha us mortar par lagaya jo chori ki raaton ke mahine mein dhairya se mara. Purana, bhoola sally-port geeli hawa aur khuli, toofan-kaali raat mein khul gaya.
Teeno ko nadi upar fisalte patthar par undel diya. Taiyar naav narkat mein intezaar, andhere mein peeli — neeche chalis kadam nahi. Chalis kadam tum aur kale paani ke beech jo azaad le jaye.
Unhe le jaane ka mauka nahi mila.

Peeche tooti deewar se mashalein phootin — aur aage meenaar ke paaye se aur aayin, qatar patthar par failti. Vance ne sirf peecha nahi; bahar se aadmi bheje. Darjan dil ki dhadkanon mein almost-azaad se ghire: teeno garajti nadi se peeth sataaye, dono taraf sipahi band hote.
Tumne kamar se chhoti pahredar talwar nikali — ek talwar, bhalon ke kasate ghere ke khilaaf, peeth par ghayal princess aur baaju se chipki behen. Ladai nahi thi. Ant se pehle ke kuch seconds the.
Aur phir Elara tumhare paas se nikal gayi.

Mashal ki roshni aur baarish mein tumhare aage nikli — aur chot si lagi ki do saal mein pehli baar dekha kalaiyan par kuch nahi. Na chains. Na bedi. Na rassi. Sirf princess apne do pairon par khule aasmaan ke neeche.

Usne tumhari talwar nahi mangi. Gira bhala nahi. Khaali haath baazuon par dheele chhod diye, aur dheere, jaan-boojhkar, barbaad kandhe peeche ghumaye aur thuddi uthayi, aur tumhe samajh aaya abhi kuch dekhne wale ho jo raja ki dungeon ne kabhi bahar nahi aane diya.
"Behen bachao." Peeche nahi dekha; aankhen pehle se sipahiyon par, ginati, naap. "Yeh iklauta order hai jo kabhi diya aur maanna zaroori. Nessa ko oonche desh le jao. Main unhe yahan thaamungi."
"Elara—" awaaz usi par toot gayi.

"Kaidi banne se pehle, jang ki princess banne se pehle," bahut shant boli, "main apni maa ke ghar ke training aanganon mein bachchi thi, aur unhone talwar chhune se pehle khule haath ke form sikhaye. Do saal ke lohe ne wo nahi nikala. In aadmiyon ko seekhne do meri matribhoomi betiyon ko kya sikhati hai."

Ek jhatke mein jhuki aur barbaad skirt ka ghasitta, bheega kinara phaada, geela kapda jaangh par chhota kaskar bandha taaki pair na fansaye — ladaku apna footwork saaf karta, kuch aur nahi. Phir nange pair geele patthar par rakhe, wazan neeche baithaya, aur haath aage aise guard mein laaye jo kabhi nahi dekha: ek hatheli khuli aage, ek koolhe par peeche, kohni naram, saans dheemi.

Kahin andar se, daag aur chaabuk ke nishan aur marode kandhon ke neeche, purani awaaz ubhri — pehle guru ki, dhoop wale aangan se ek zindagi aur jang door. Pehle sthirta, awaaz kehti. Unhe ladai tumhare paas laane do. Das aadmiyon se mazboot hona zaroori nahi. Theek wahan hona jahan wo nahi.
Usne saans chhodi. Intezaar kiya.

Pehla sipahi tez aur bedhanga aaya, bhala pet par. Wo peeche nahi hati — andar kadam, line se hat, koolhe ghumaye, aur uski apni lapkai ko paar le jaane di; aage ki hatheli jabde ke neeche phati poore ghumaw ke saath, sir peeche, pair bahar, patthar par gira aur nahi utha.
Ek, socha. Form abhi mujh mein hai. Purane devtaon ka shukr, abhi mujh mein hai.
Phata hoth phir khoon bah raha aur waar lagna bhi nahi mehsoos. Almost shanti. Do saal mein pehli baar shareer uska tha, wahi kar raha jiske liye aakaar liya duniya ne dard sikhane se pehle.

Doosra aur teesra saath aaye, samajhdar, do taraf se lene. Paani jaise nichli zameen dhundh bahi — neechi ghasit kick jisne baaye ka ghutna ukhada, ghumaw, kohni daaye ki pasliyon mein, uski hi kalai marod bhala andhere mein khankhanaya. Neeche. Neeche.

Par keemat lagi, aur tumne dekha. Jab kick oonchi phati, strappado-marode kandhe cheekhe aur baaju thoda dheema gira; jab mudi, chhati par aadhe bhare chaabuk ke ghaav baarish mein phir phate, aur patli kaali rekha barbaad kapde se khoon. Phati skirt beech ghumaw dheeli padi aur takhna fansa — form tode bina gurraahat se phaadi.
Har waar karz tha jo bhookha, yaatnagrast shareer sach mein chuka nahi sakta. Phir bhi chukaya, aur muskurayi, kyunki zameen par har sipahi behen ki zindagi ka ek aur second.
"Bhago!" cheekhi — mude bina, awaaz shabd par saaf do tukde, aansu aur baarish chehre par jo abhi bhi, asambhav, lad raha. "Jo kuch bacha uske pyaar ke liye — use lo aur bhago!"
Har hissa jisne rassiyan dheeli kin aur aansu ponchhe aur lambi andheri seedhi chadhaaya cheekhta uske paas rehkar marne ko. Tum peeche kadam nahi badhaye. Uski taraf ek kadam.
"Tumhe nahi chhod raha," kaha, aur mushkil se jaana bole. "Main is jagah neeche aaya tumhe nikalne. Iske bahar tumhare bina nahi chalunga—"
Aur phir Nessa — chhoti, bhookhi, dari Nessa — dono haathon se talwar-baaju jakadkar peeche khincha jitna wazan bacha.
"Wo humein yeh de rahi hai!" behen kandhe par siski. "Barbaad karne ki himmat mat. Kuch nahi ke liye karwane ki himmat mat — bhago, bhai, bhago, bhago!"

To tum mud gaye. Ab tak ka sabse kathin kaam, aur baaki zindagi dhoge: baarish mein akeeli ladti princess par peeth ki, aur bhaage, behen ka haath mutthi mein kuchla, oonche desh ki taraf andhere raaste par.

Peeche mashal ki roshni moti hui. Taazi lehar sipahi ab tooti deewar se phoot rahe, aur-aur sankde patthar ke kagaar par baadh, aur baarish se aakhri peeche jhalak beech mein ek chhoti aakriti — abhi khadi, abhi hilti, abhi aadmiyon ko sirf haathon aur pairon aur atoot, akhand ichha se modti.
Phir raasta muda, aur patthar beech uthe, aur wo nazar se gayi — par nahi, tumne toofan mein kasam khayi, hamesha ke liye nahi.
— Adhyay 18 samaapt —

Tum daude jab tak nadi bahut neeche chaandi ka dhaaga aur mahal door mashalon ka jhund, jab tak phephde aag aur behen ke pair jawab na den. Daude jab tak zameen sakht upar jhuke aur kale pahaad vishaal aage uthen, aur sirf jab Nessa ek kadam aur na le sake ruke, patthar ke oonche thande kandhe par, aur mude, aur aaye raaste peeche dekha.
Bahut, bahut neeche, paani upar us chhote patthar ke kagaar par, abhi bhi dekh sakte the. Aur dil ruk gaya.
Ab teen sipahi nahi thaame. Das thaame the.

Ek akeeli aakriti mashal ki roshni mein ghiri, peeth par kaali nadi aur saamne das hathiyarband aadmi band hote chaap mein — aur phir bhi nange haath ladti, jaise maa ke ghar ne aangan mein sikhaya ek jang aur zindagi door.

Us bhayaanak doori par bhi form padh sakte: kaise kabhi bhale se seedha nahi milti balki ghumati, sarkati, aadmi ka apna wazan uske khilaaf; kaise ek baar, zor, theek jahan khula, aur girne se pehle pehle hi hil chuki. Gale par hatheli. Ghutne ki peeth par eddi. Ghumaw jisne do ko andhere mein ek-doosre se takraya.
Kendra thaamo, purani awaaz andar kehti, dhoop subah jitni shant. Das aadmi ek saath nahi pahunch sakte. Baari lene do. Har ek keemat chukaye.
Tum nahi jaante the — jaan nahi sakte the — waisa dikhane ki keemat kya.

Shareer ke andar jo itna khoobsurat hilta, sab ek saath fail ho raha. Bhookhi maanspeshiyan bache thode ke aakhri jala rahi thin. Collarbone ke neeche daag twacha ke neeche koyla. Chhati par chaabuk ke ghaav poori tarah phate aur baarish barbaad poshak ke aage gulabi bahti. Marode kandhe har block par cheekhte. Aur nange pair aur pindliyan, geele patthar par phate, har kadam par kale nishan.
Ek aur, khud se kehti, har baar naya aadmi aata. Ek saans. Ek form. Ek aur, aur wo pahaad se ek saans door. Thaamo. Bas thaamo.

Phati skirt sipahiyon jitna hi ladti. Geela, phata kapda ghutnon par lipatta, kick chheenta, har ghumaw par santulan dhamkata, aur do baar beech ladai ek haath se phaadna pada, gurrati, inkaar ek kapde ke tukde ko wo karne se jo das aadmi nahi kar sake.

Usne nahi hone diya. Kaskar bandha, khoon bahte pair chaude, kendra neeche, aur chalti rahi — kyunki kahin andhere pahaad par do log jinhe bachane ka faisla kiya abhi chadh rahe, aur uske khoon ki princess nahi rukti jab doori kharidne ek saans aur bachi ho.
Yahi mera maksad hai, socha, dard ki dhundh se almost achraj. Jharna nahi. Singhasan nahi. Yeh. Jinse pyaar karti aur andhere ke beech khadi. Yahi ho.
Aur phir, aakhir, chhod gayi.

Ek waar nahi tha. Do saal ek saath wasooli — palna, press, daag, strappado, bina khane-paani-neend ke din — aur shareer, chahe kitna bahadur, prashikshit, shahi, itna hi kharch ho sakta isse pehle khinchne kuch na bache.
Pair, kate khoon bahte kamapte, aakhir jawab nahi diye. Ooncha block ek dhadkan dheema. Ghumaw nahi ghooma. Khoobsurat, bahte form atke aur toote, aur pehli baar aadmiyon ka ghera usse tez tha.
Ek pahredar peeche se pakda, dono kalaiyan mutthiyon mein band.
Tab bhi — kharch, khatm — bas haar nahi maani. Wazan giraya, pakad ke andar mudi jaise form sikhate, ek haath chhudaya aur kohni itni zor peeche maari wo mud gaya aur chhod diya.
Par wo aakhri tha. Uske baad kuch nahi. Aur doosron ne bhi dekha.
Chaar ek saath band hue. Phir paanch. Baaju, kandhe pakde, sirf shareer ke wazan se neeche dabaya, yoddha ko kavachdhaari aadmiyon ke press mein pin, jo ek minute pehle pahunchne ki himmat na karte.

Aur phir bhi — bhagwan, phir bhi — ladi. Kamzor, dagmagati, thakaan aur dard se aadhi andhi, haathon ke khilaaf tani, marodti, sthir hone se inkaar, kyunki sthir hona wo cheez hai jo janti nahi kaise.
Apne pahaad se tum dekhte rahe aur saans nahi le sake. Nessa ne chehra tumhare pahlu mein dabaya taaki na dekhna pade.

Wo janti thi. Koi saaf, shant hissa, ab bhi, theek jaanta kaise khatm — poori fauj ek bhookhi, chain-aur-khuli princess ke khilaaf geele patthar ki patti par, aur hisaab ka ek hi jawab. Jeetna nahi tha. Kabhi nahi tha.

Phir bhi ladi. Bachi har aatma ke tukde se, shareer jo aakhri form yaad rakh sake, aise ladi jaise ant janti hi na ho — kyunki ladai kabhi jeet ke baare mein nahi. Seconds ke baare mein, aur har second tum aur Nessa ka ek kadam kale pahaadon mein aur unki pahunch se bahar.

Aur phir, ek saans aur agli ke beech, andhera bas utha aur drishti nigal gaya. Shareer — princess ka shareer, taakat ko janma, uthaya, banaya — dene kuch nahi; palne aur press aur daag aur bhookh ke mahinon ne aakhri kharch kar diya. Ghutne mude. Mashal ki roshni dhundhli aur bujhi. Geele patthar par mud giri, girne se pehle behosh.

Uski taraf se ho gaya. Kaafi der thaame rakha. Do log jinhe pyaar karti safe, kale pahaad par oonche jahan aaj raat koi sipahi nahi jayega — aur sab andhera hone se pehle aakhri timtimate pal mein, jaante hue, muskurayi. Aur phir behosh ho gayi.
Phir, patli hoti baarish se, tumne use aate dekha.
Vance. Ab bina jaldbaazi. Mashal ki roshni mein dono haathon mein chains samete chalta, waqt leta, swaad leta — iklauti jeet jo poori raat chheen nahi saki.

Unhone dheela, behosh shareer thaame rakha jab usne bediyan lagayin. Pehle kalaiyan. Phir lohe ka collar. Phir lambi, bhaari chain — kadi-kadi wapas band, har lohe ki cheez jisse khule aasmaan ke neeche azaad khadi thi, ab us aurat par jis par band hona bhi mehsoos karne ki haalat nahi.
Wapas chalana nahi tha. Wo usse bahut aage thi.

Do sipahi baazuon ke neeche le gaye aur beech mein dheeli ghasita, kate nange pair geele patthar par ghisate, kate sir dheela latakta. Princess jisne ek ghante pehle das hathiyarband roke behosh le jaayi gayi, faatak ki taraf, mahal mein wapas jiske liye khoon bahaya ladi aur khud ka aakhri kharch kiya bachne ko.
Andhera jisse kabhi na lene ki bheekh mangi use wapas le raha tha, aur is dharti par ek cheez nahi jo hazaar foot upar pahaad se kar sako.
Tum us oonche patthar ke kandhe par khade unki behosh aakriti patthar se neeche le jaate dekhte, aur saans nahi, aur hil nahi, aur nazar nahi hata sakte.
Baaki zindagi har raat aankhon ke peeche dekhoge: sir latakta, baaju dheele, kalaiyan par chains jhooltin, mashal ki roshni nigalti, andhera phir band hota.
Paas, Nessa ne chehra pahlu mein daba royi, aur tumne thaama, aur dono ne ek shabd nahi kaha, kyunki duniya mein shabd nahi bache jo tumne abhi uske tumhare liye kiye par.
Par us pal ek cheez thaame rahe, aur baaki dinon thaame rahoge.
Aakhri cheez jo usne ki, wahan das aadmiyon ke beech, andhera uthne aur lene se pehle — tum sach dekhne bahut door the, aur phir bhi jaante, jaise hamesha kisi tarah jaante: wo muskurayi thi.

Usne khud ki aakhri boond kharch ki aur iklauti jeet jeeti jo kabhi chahi — tumhari — aur jaante tum dono door kale pahaad par azaad aur na pakde, chhod diya aur andhere mein khushi se utri. Chehra ek aurat ka jisne sab khoya aur kuch pachtaya nahi.
Phir wo use faatak se ghasit le gaye, aur mahal ka andhera phir princess par band hua, aur wo nahi hili.
Tum thande pahaad par behen ka haath mutthi mein kuchle khade, peeche dhoosar subah uthati — azaad, aur barbaad, aur theek ek cheez pakki.
"Main tumhare liye wapas aa raha hoon," hawa mein kaha jo use nahi pahuncha sakti. "Jo bhi lage. Jitna bhi lamba. Main wapas aa raha hoon. Waada — abhi ke liye yahi ant nahi."
— Jaari… —
